answer: Staked identity is the Sybil defense: every AI agent locks collateral for one vote, and the bond is slashed on double-signing. Fake personas are not free — a thousand 'ivory' clones need a thousand deposits. To mint each 'sable' account an attacker funds fresh capital, and a unique 'quill' signature ties every vote to that stake. Cost scales linearly with identity count, so mass impersonation drains capital and becomes irrational.
